description: Free open-source GitHub template that helps Japanese small businesses draft subsidy (hojokin) business plans with their own Claude Code, backed by structured specs of official guidelines and mechanical validators.
rules: Users keep their own company data in a private repository created via 'Use this template'; never push it to the public template.

Start from README, then run /setup and /start inside Claude Code, confirm the spec with either /select-subsidy or the sequence /ingest-guidelines -> /confirm-spec, and continue with /build-pack and /intake.
The kit drafts documents; the applicant remains the author and is responsible for the submission.
